t: This is Ideal House, now called Palladium House, a Grade II listed Art Deco office building on the corner of Great Marlborough Street and Argyll Street. It was designed by two architects. One was the American Raymond Hood, whose best-known works include the Tribune Tower, the American Radiator Building and Rockefeller Center. The other was the English architect S. Gordon Jeeves. Hood worked in the Neo-Gothic and Art Deco styles, and the Art Deco character is plain to see on this corner.
